spec.rawSql:
with baseline as (
  select time
  from stat_statements
  where dbname = '$dbname'
    and tag_data @> '{"queryid": "$queryid"}'
    and time < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
  order by time desc
  limit 1
)
select
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg(case when c = c_lag then null else ((CASE WHEN read >= read_lag THEN read - read_lag ELSE read END)::numeric * 8192) / nullif(CASE WHEN c >= c_lag THEN c - c_lag ELSE c END, 0) end) as "Temp Bytes read",
  avg(case when c = c_lag then null else ((CASE WHEN written >= written_lag THEN written - written_lag ELSE written END)::numeric * 8192) / nullif(CASE WHEN c >= c_lag THEN c - c_lag ELSE c END, 0) end) as "Temp Bytes written"
from (
  select
    (data->>'temp_blks_read')::int8 as read, lag((data->>'temp_blks_read')::int8) over w as read_lag,
    (data->>'temp_blks_written')::int8 as written, lag((data->>'temp_blks_written')::int8) over w as written_lag,
    (data->>'calls')::int8 as c, lag((data->>'calls')::int8) over w as c_lag,
    time
  from stat_statements
  where dbname = '$dbname'
    and tag_data @> '{"queryid": "$queryid"}'
    and time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    and time >= coalesce((select time from baseline), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)
  window w as (order by time)
) x
where time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
group by 1
order by 1

spec.title: Backend block Read/Write time
spec.description: FYI - blk_write_time can easily be 0 as normally changes happen only in the shared buffers and are written out by the checkpointer / background writer.

spec.rawSql:
with baseline as (
  select time
  from stat_statements
  where dbname = '$dbname'
    and tag_data @> '{"queryid": "$queryid"}'
    and time < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
  order by time desc
  limit 1
)
select
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  sum(CASE WHEN read >= read_lag THEN read - read_lag ELSE read END) / nullif(extract(epoch from sum(time - time_lag)), 0) as "blk_read_time",
  sum(CASE WHEN write >= write_lag THEN write - write_lag ELSE write END) / nullif(extract(epoch from sum(time - time_lag)), 0) as "blk_write_time"
from (
  select
    (data->>'blk_read_time')::numeric as read, lag((data->>'blk_read_time')::numeric) over w as read_lag,
    (data->>'blk_write_time')::numeric as write, lag((data->>'blk_write_time')::numeric) over w as write_lag,
    time, lag(time) over w as time_lag
  from stat_statements
  where dbname = '$dbname'
    and tag_data @> '{"queryid": "$queryid"}'
    and time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    and time >= coalesce((select time from baseline), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)
  window w as (order by time)
) x
where time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
group by 1
order by 1
